scanType.description: Kind of observation (ADR 0002 A5). Each type has fixed edges: SHIPMENT_CONFIRMED (LABELLED stays), PICKUP_DEPARTURE (LABELLED to HANDED_OVER), DEPARTURE (HANDED_OVER or IN_TRANSIT to IN_TRANSIT), TRANSIT_ARRIVAL (HANDED_OVER or IN_TRANSIT to IN_TRANSIT), STATION_ARRIVAL (HANDED_OVER or IN_TRANSIT to AT_STATION), CARRIER_HANDOFF (AT_STATION to WITH_CARRIER, ADR 0015), OUT_FOR_DELIVERY (AT_STATION or WITH_CARRIER to OUT_FOR_DELIVERY), DELIVERED (OUT_FOR_DELIVERY to DELIVERED), DELIVERY_FAILED (OUT_FOR_DELIVERY to AT_STATION, or to WITH_CARRIER for a journey with a carrier choice: the carrier re-attempts from its own custody).
